title: 電気基礎
subtitle: Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn the basic of electronics for a machine engineer (2) Learn the basic concepts such as electric current and voltage (3) Learn the principles and the functions such as resistor, condenser and coil (4) Learn the principle of motor
advice: This is a basic course in electric engineering. Step 1: students will understand the concepts as follows, electric current, voltage, resistance, electric power, magnetic field, magnetic force, alternating current, electric field Step 2: students will understand the laws and use them as follows, Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's current law, Joule's law, Coulomb's law, Ampere's law, Biot-Savart law, Fleming's law, Faraday's law Step 3: students will apply them to electric circuits and equipments as follows, voltage and current measurement, Wheatstone bridge, heater, temperature measurement, electromagnetic induction, motor, electric transformer, electric storage
books: Text book: Introduction to Electrical Engineering, Morikita Publishing (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: Students are required basic mathematical skills. It is desirable to understand differentiation and integration.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the difference between direct current and alternating current.
Be able to explain the relationship between current, voltage, and power throuhg a resistor.
Be able to explain the functions of a condenser and a coil.
Be able to explain the principle of a motor.

(2) Calculate the voltage, the current and the power of resistors connected in parallel or in series. (3) Explain the role of condenser s and coils. (4) Explain Fleming's left-hand rule.
